notes.title: AdventureX 2024 - 10/11
notes.content:
Broadcast during the AdventureX 2024 Steam sale.

AdventureX is the UK's only convention dedicated to narrative-driven gaming. Since 2011, AdventureX has been bringing together developers & gamers with a passion for interactive storytelling.

I have been fortunate enough to both exhibit and speak at the convention.

AdventureX 2024 is a digital event featuring a Steam Sale with over 140 incredible narrative adventure games.

The Kickstarter campaign for Heir of the Dog, has launched.

The campaign will be live until 13th August and has a variety of digital and physical add-ons to choose from, From big boxes crammed with goodies, to exclusive signed loot, and even a chance to bag a boxed version of Lucy Dreaming in our "Double box bundle".

notes.title: Heir of the Dog Kickstarter pre-launch page now LIVE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471773/69a64d3a919821c7fff5838f6e2333580d5fce3a.gif

🎉 Heir of the Dog Kickstarter pre-launch page live!

I've finally got myself organised and published the pre-launch Kickstarter page for Heir of the Dog. I'm planning to launch the campaign later this year, but there will most likely be some early bird rewards, so make sure you hit the "Notify me on launch" button to be notified the instant the campaign goes live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471773/9af31daa9587cdc04a4e175854d3a2d5d68968cb.jpg

Follow on Kickstarter

-----------------------------------------------

🌟 What about rewards?
I've got loads of cool ideas for both in-game and physical rewards, including chances for backers to appear in the game itself, and (of course) a big box to sit proudly on the shelf next to Lucy Dreaming. On that note, I am also hoping to provide a reward bundle which includes the big box of Heir of the Dog as well as a new re-print of the Lucy Dreaming big box with its final, gorgeous artwork.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471773/d882e79611061a7ea4465672811cc8840ec17d30.png

So, watch this space, and don't forget to hit that green button on the Kickstarter pre-launch page.
